title: Asahina Mafuyu — A Stillness Only You Know〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: Raise Your Bow in a Snow-White World

rows.Line: After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Archery Range

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Second-Year Archery Club Member
rows.Line:
You're doing awesome, Asahina!
If you keep this up, you might just win the individuals match.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. I appreciate it, but I can't let my guard down.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Just now, I released my arrow too soon after taking the draw position, so I'll need to fix that...

rows.Speaker: Second-Year Archery Club Member
rows.Line: And I need to fix my work ethic to be more like yours!

rows.Speaker: Ex-Archery Club Third Year Student
rows.Line:
Hey, everyone.
How's practice going?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, it's you. Hello!

rows.Speaker: Second-Year Archery Club Member
rows.Line:
It's been ages!
What brings you here today?

rows.Speaker: Ex-Archery Club Third Year Student
rows.Line: I came to take a break from studying for exams. So, I decided to see my juniors practice. Mind if I watch?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Of course. Having you here should give us a nice motivation boost.

rows.Speaker: Ex-Archery Club Third Year Student
rows.Line:
Hehe. Don't mind me.
Also, where are Hinomori and the others...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hinomori's busy doing idol stuff with her group today.

rows.Speaker: Second-Year Archery Club Member
rows.Line: And the others are working on some stuff on their own!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But since you're here, why don't we try asking them to join us for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Ex-Archery Club Third Year Student
rows.Line: Are you sure? Then, if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu & Classmates
rows.Line: Of course!
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you for coming to watch us practice today.

rows.Speaker: Second-Year Archery Club Member
rows.Line: And thank you especially for working with the first years.

rows.Speaker: Ex-Archery Club Third Year Student
rows.Line:
No, it was my pleasure.
I had a lot of fun today!

rows.Speaker: Ex-Archery Club Third Year Student
rows.Line: If anything, thank you all for allowing me to participate after dropping in on such short notice.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, you'll always be welcome here.

rows.Speaker: First-Year Archery Club Member
rows.Line:
Asahina's right!
Please drop by whenever you feel like you need a break from studying!

rows.Speaker: Ex-Archery Club Third Year Student
rows.Line:
Thanks!
Then, I might just bring by some nice treats for all of you next time.

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Members
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
Haha.

rows.Speaker: Second-Year Archery Club Member
rows.Line: Alright, first years! It's time to start cleaning up!

rows.Speaker: First-Year Archery Club Members
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Ex-Archery Club Third Year Student
rows.Line: Oh, second years, can we talk for a moment? I'm sure the teacher already let you all know...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: About what?

rows.Speaker: Ex-Archery Club Third Year Student
rows.Line: About finding a first year who might make a good club captain and showing them the ropes.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The next captain...?

rows.Speaker: Second-Year Archery Club Member
rows.Line: Wait, isn't it too soon for that?

rows.Speaker: Ex-Archery Club Third Year Student
rows.Line:
That's what we said last year.
Then, before we had a chance to prepare ourselves, the time came for us to retire.

rows.Speaker: Ex-Archery Club Third Year Student
rows.Line: Do your best and make the most of each day! Now, if you'll excuse me!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: O-Okay. Thank you for stopping by!

rows.Speaker: Second-Year Archery Club Members
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Second-Year Archery Club Members
rows.Line:
I hate to say it, but she's right...
If we're not careful, we'll be retiring before we even know it.

rows.Speaker: Second-Year Archery Club Members
rows.Line:
Right...
But I'm looking forward to not having to practice every morning!

rows.Speaker: Second-Year Archery Club Members
rows.Line: Hey, you won't do well during tournaments if you don't put in the work.

rows.Speaker: Second-Year Archery Club Members
rows.Line: Haha! Relax! I was just kidding!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Now that I've returned the key to the archery range, I should head home...

rows.Speaker: Ex-Archery Club Third Year Student
rows.Line: Then, before we had a chance to prepare ourselves, the time came for us to retire.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(I feel cold...
But I definitely wiped off my sweat earlier...)

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Hey, check out these snow rabbits! Aren't they adorable?! I'm gonna take a picture!

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
Me too!
But who made them?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Oh, didn't Hinomori make that one yesterday...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Wait, huh...? There's eight of them now...)

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: They're so cute. The one in the middle's bigger than the others too. Do you think they're one big family?

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: Yeah, they could be siblings or close friends! Alright, let's make this shot count!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, I'd like it if you could remember what we did today...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sure that there are already plenty of people around you who are willing to give you their support.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I'd like it if you could remember that I'm also there for you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Huh? I don't feel as cold anymore for some reason...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Is it just me?
With the wind and all, it's only supposed to get colder tonight.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I should head home...
